## Summary

Describe the behavior change and link the related issue.

## Validation

List the commands and environments used to test the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] User-facing or security-sensitive behavior is documented
- [ ] No local configuration, device identifiers, or captured input is included

Pull requests are reviewed here, then accepted changes are integrated into the
project's working tree and credited in the next release. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
